journey.name: Screen Navigation and Backstack Verification
journey.description: Verifies step-by-step forward navigation and backward navigation between screens in the Uber Trip app using system back gestures/actions.

actions.action: Verify that the app launches on the Start screen with the "Start" button displayed.
Tap the "Start" button. Verify navigation to the distance screen showing "Enter the total distance".
Type "5" into "Distance in kilometers" and tap "Next". Verify navigation to "Enter the total time".
Navigate back using the system back action. Verify that the app returns to the "Enter the total distance" screen.
Tap "Next" to return to "Enter the total time".
Type "10" into "Time in minutes" and tap "Next". Verify navigation to the traffic options screen displaying "Calculate Trip Price".
Navigate back using the system back action. Verify that the app returns to the "Enter the total time" screen.
